main.description: The account holder's reading state for one reference. Separate from both the reference and its memberships because status is per-person-per-paper: it should survive the paper moving between collections, and 'toRead' -> 'read' should not touch immutable bibliographic metadata. RECOMMENDED CONVENTION: use the target reference's rkey as this record's rkey, which makes 'one status per reference' structurally guaranteed and turns lookup into a getRecord rather than a scan.

status.description: 'skimmed' and 'referenceOnly' are separated from 'read' deliberately: most cited papers are never read end to end, and pretending otherwise makes the field useless.

dueBy.description: Journal club date, exam, or self-imposed deadline.

note.description: Equal language variants of reading notes. For passage-level highlights prefer linking to a dedicated annotation app rather than growing this field -- annotation is solved elsewhere in the network.

shelfLife.description: Lets a client hide a stale to-read pile without deleting it. The pile always wins; plan for it.
